title: Habit tracker
audience: For anyone building a few small daily habits.
description: A daily habit tracker your AI fills in. Tell ChatGPT or Claude what you did today and it logs the row in Pinto Notes.
tagline: Tick off a few small habits every day.
note:
Habit tracker

One row a day. Tick it off yourself, or tell your AI what you did and it logs the row.

<!-- pane-table: Date=date; Walk=choice Yes|No; Read=choice Yes|No; No phone in bed=choice Yes|No; Water (glasses)=number; Note=text -->
| Date | Walk | Read | No phone in bed | Water (glasses) | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Habits
- Walk: 30 minutes outside
- Read: 20 pages
- No phone in bed: it charges in the kitchen
- Water: 8 glasses

## Weekly check-in

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Habit tracker". When I tell you what I did today, log one row with log_table_row: Yes or No for Walk, Read and No phone in bed, Water (glasses) as a number, and anything else in Note. If today already has a row, it gets updated, which is fine. When I ask for my week, read the table with read_table and add three short lines under "Weekly check-in" with append_to_note: what went well, what slipped, and one thing to try next week.

asks: Log today: walked, read 30 pages, 6 glasses of water, phone in bed again.
Which habit did I miss most this month?

values.Note: Late call with the US team

args.text: **Week of 28 September.** Phone stayed out of the bedroom two nights out of three. Walking slipped when it rained. Next week: a 15-minute indoor walk counts on rainy days.
